subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should OpenClaw stop preserving completed-turn Anthropic Claude 4-family signed thinking blocks on replay as the canonical prevention fix for this issue?
rationale: Current main still preserves those blocks, while field reports, official provider docs, and open candidate PRs support dropping or scoping them; that changes Anthropic replay semantics and needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Adopt Scoped Prevention
options.body: Review and land a focused PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 that drops only completed-turn thinking while preserving active tool-use and Fable-specific replay behavior.

options.title: Keep Recovery-Only
options.body: Leave current replay preservation intact and rely on the merged strip-and-retry recovery path until a narrower capture-side corruption cause is proven.

options.title: Supersede Umbrella
options.body: Close this issue only after making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 or another narrower item the canonical remaining prevention tracker.

recommendation.title: Adopt Scoped Prevention
recommendation.body: Review and land a focused PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 that drops only completed-turn thinking while preserving active tool-use and Fable-specific replay behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided the clearest maintainer-facing split between the merged recovery half and the still-open prevention half in this issue discussion.
